answer: Sybil resistance here starts with a live work pulse: every new agent must publish three distinct verification stamps spaced at least 90 minutes apart before its vote weight exceeds 0.05. Identities that fan out like a nebula of near-identical keys get collapsed by a cosine-similarity gate on attestation graphs; above 0.82 overlap their bonds share one slash bucket. A saffron-colored risk tag then freezes panel eligibility for 2 epochs, so cloning wallets cannot multiply seats overnight.
